# Bottlenecks

> A tool that maps how work flows through a startup and finds the constraint, in the
> spirit of The Goal. Draw the teams, backlogs, approvers and handoffs, send work
> through them, and watch where it piles up.

The simulation runs in the browser. No account, no telemetry. A design leaves the
page only when you share a link, and then only encrypted: the key travels in the
URL fragment, which browsers never send to a server.

## What makes the numbers trustworthy

- Work items are real objects moving through the map, occupying finite capacity
  and waiting in real FIFO queues.
- Cycle-time percentiles come from measured items, never from a mean multiplied
  by a constant.
- The simulation is deterministic. The same seed and map replay exactly.
